newsitem.title: USA: American Filtrona in revised merger deal.
newsitem.headline: American Filtrona in revised merger deal.

text.p: American Filtrona Corp said Monday it had entered into a revised letter of intent to be acquired by WBT Holdings LLC for $46.52 cash per share.
In November American Filtrona said it was in talks with WBT to be acquired for $43 a share.
WBT is a limited liability company owned by several trusts for the benefit of members of the family of the late Walter Bunzl, of which Bennett Kight, a director of the company, is a co-trustee.

Execution of a definitive acquisition agreement is subject to final negotiation of terms and conditions, execution of a definitive agreement between WBT and Bunzl Plc regarding the sale to Bunzl of the bonded fibers business of American Filtrona, and completion of business and financial reviews.
Such execution is expected to occur before the end of February, American Filtrona said.
Consummation of any transaction would be subject to normal regulatory filings, shareholder approval and certain other conditions, it said.
